metadata.title: Create Detailed Step Plans
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Generate detailed implementation plans for each step in an approved high-level plan. Breaks down high-level steps into actionable sub-steps, identifies missing information through Q&A, creates step-specific Low Level Designs, and links each plan to a process-step.

output.description: Detailed plan files for each high-level step

prerequisites: All required process-steps exist in .processes/steps/ library
specificActions: Load High-Level Plan: Read approved high-level plan from plans/{user-story-name}/plan.md
For Each Step: Create detailed plan file, analyze requirements, add Q&A if needed, create LLD, link to process-step, break into sub-steps
Q&A Section: Add when step-specific technical details are missing (API contracts, database details, configuration, business logic)
Low Level Design: Create component overview, architecture diagram, files to create/modify, key classes/interfaces, data flow, error handling, dependencies
Link Process Step: Use format @step:category/step-name, verify step exists
Present for Approval: Show all plans organized, with summary and approval request
Handle Revisions: If changes requested, revise affected plans and re-present
Complete When Approved: Exit only when user explicitly approves all plans

read: memory.json (previous step section with plan directory)
update: memory.json (current step section with plans index and approval status)

tools: read_file - Read high-level plan and memory
bestPractices: Never assume technical details - add Q&A if step-specific info is missing
Be specific in Q&A questions - ask about concrete implementation details
Wait for Q&A answers before creating LLD
Verify linked process-step exists before referencing
This step is self-contained - includes creation, Q&A, revision, and approval workflow

substeps.name: Load High-Level Plan
substeps.description: Read the approved high-level plan from previous step
actions: Read memory.json to get high-level plan path
Read the approved plan.md file
Extract list of steps to create detailed plans for

substeps.name: Create Detailed Plan for Each Step
substeps.description: For each step in the high-level plan, create a detailed plan file
actions: Create file: step-{n}-{step-name}.md
Add Overview and Parent Plan reference
Analyze if step-specific information is missing
If missing: Add Q&A section with specific questions
If Q&A added: Wait for user to answer before proceeding

substeps.name: Create Step-Specific Low Level Design
substeps.description: After Q&A resolved, create the technical design for each step
actions: Create Component Overview (no code)
Create Architecture Diagram (mermaid)
List Files to Create/Modify
Document Key Classes/Interfaces
Describe Data Flow and Error Handling
List Dependencies

substeps.name: Link to Process Step
substeps.description: Link each detailed plan to the process-step that will execute it
actions: Identify appropriate process-step (e.g., @step:api/implement-controller-layer)
Verify process-step exists in .processes/steps/
Add Linked Process Step section with reference and description
If process-step doesn't exist: Flag for creation before proceeding

substeps.name: Break Down into Sub-Steps
substeps.description: Break each step into actionable implementation sub-steps
actions: Create numbered sub-steps ({n}.1, {n}.2, etc.)
Add complexity rating to each sub-step (keep < 7)
Include details and expected output for each
Add Testing Considerations and Success Criteria sections

substeps.name: Present Plans for Approval
substeps.description: Present all detailed plans to user in organized format
actions: List all plans with: file, linked process-step, complexity, sub-steps count, Q&A status
Show summary: total plans, total sub-steps, total complexity
Request approval: 'approved' to proceed, or specify changes needed

substeps.name: Handle Revisions
substeps.description: If user requests changes, revise and re-present
actions: Identify affected plans from user feedback
Make requested changes to plan files
Add revision note with description of changes
Re-present revised plans to user
Repeat until user approves all plans

substeps.name: Finalize Approval
actions: Mark all plans as Approved in memory.json
Record approval timestamp
Update current step section with plans index

flow.description: Load plan → For each step: create file → Q&A if needed → create LLD → link process-step → sub-steps → Present all → Handle revisions → Finalize approval

memoryFileUsage.readFrom: Previous step section (high-level plan path, approval status)
fields: Information Produced: Detailed plans index (step, file, process-step, status, approval date)
Decisions Made: Process-step selections, complexity ratings
Approval Timestamp: When all plans were approved

qaGuidance.whenToAdd: When step-specific technical details are missing that are necessary for implementation
